name: Bleed
description: Inflicts steady bleed damage that stacks with each hit.

name: Brood Mother
description: Spawns parasitic offspring that overwhelm the arena.

name: Fire
description: Engulfs targets in lingering flames that scorch armor and flesh.

name: Cell
description: A living nucleus that adapts quickly to any battlefield threat.

name: Charm
description: Bends foes to your will through irresistible allure.
descripcion: Seduce o manipula a los enemigos.

name: Dark
description: Channels forbidden shadow energy to curse and drain enemies.

name: Earthquake
description: Shakes the ground with destructive tremors that topple formations.

name: Egg Sack
description: Packed with hatchlings ready to burst forth on impact.

name: Freeze
description: Encases opponents in ice, slowing them to a crawl.
descripcion: Congela a los enemigos y ralentiza su movimiento.

name: Ghost
description: Slips through walls and foes alike, ignoring physical barriers.

name: Iron
description: A dense sphere that rebounds with brutal force and barely dents.
descripcion: Sólida y resistente, con rebotes potentes.

name: Laser
description: Fires concentrated energy beams that pierce straight lines.

name: Light
description: Bathes the arena in purifying radiance that reveals hidden threats.

name: Lightning
description: Unleashes chained bolts that race between clustered targets.

name: Poison
description: Corrodes enemies over time with toxic spores.

name: Vampire
description: Drains vitality from every collision to sustain the wielder.

name: Wind
description: Commands swirling gusts that redirect trajectories midair.

name: Leech
description: Clings to enemies and siphons their lifeblood relentlessly.
descripcion: Fusión que crea una sanguijuela que absorbe vida.

name: Frenzy
description: Explodes with reckless aggression, trading control for ferocity.
descripcion: Incrementa el ataque al costo de perder control.

name: Sacrifice
description: Converts your own life force into devastating annihilation.
descripcion: Convierte tu vida en poder destructivo.

name: Hemorrhage
description: Deepens every wound until foes collapse from blood loss.

name: Vampire Lord
description: An apex predator that feeds continuously on the battlefield.
descripcion: Versión superior que roba vida de forma constante.

name: Larva
description: A primordial creature that evolves rapidly into new threats.
descripcion: Crea una nueva forma biológica primigenia.

name: Spider Queen
description: Commands venomous broods that blanket the arena in webs.

name: Mosquito King
description: Aerial leech that drains foes from above with relentless bites.

name: Magma
description: Spills molten rock trails that sear anything they touch.
descripcion: Genera un núcleo ardiente que quema el suelo.

name: Frozen Flame
description: Balances opposing elements to flash-freeze and cauterise at once.
descripcion: Une fuego y hielo en equilibrio mortal.

name: Bomb
description: Detonates on command to obliterate clustered enemies.

name: Sun
description: Radiates constant warmth that heals allies and burns invaders.

name: Inferno
description: Summons a living wildfire that devours the battlefield.
descripcion: Llama viva que arrasa con todo.

name: Overgrowth
description: Unleashes rampant biomass that overruns terrain instantly.

name: Radioactive Beam
description: Fuses light and toxin into a beam that irradiates targets.
descripcion: Fusión de energía pura y biología.

name: Virus
description: Spreads a fast-acting plague that debilitates entire waves.
descripcion: Crea un patógeno de rápida propagación.

name: Incubus
description: A shadowy tempter that feeds on the desires of prey.

name: Enamored
description: Charms everything nearby into a lovestruck stupor.

name: Succubus
description: Drains strength while entrancing foes with allure.
descripcion: Encanta y drena a sus víctimas.

name: Apparition
description: A spectral chill that freezes and haunts simultaneously.

name: Assassin
description: Strikes from the shadows with surgical lethality.

name: Flash
description: Releases a brief union of light and darkness that blinds.
descripcion: Breve unión entre luz y oscuridad.

name: Noxious
description: Blankets the arena in invisible, choking toxins.

name: Glacier
description: Raises colossal ice walls that trap foes in permafrost.

name: Swamp
description: Floods the ground with mire that poisons every step.

name: Sandstorm
description: Scours the battlefield with blinding, abrasive winds.
descripcion: Reduce la visibilidad y movilidad enemiga.

name: Scattershot
description: Blasts short-range shrapnel in a brutal cone.

name: Mosquito Swarm
description: A buzzing cloud that drains life from every angle.

name: Ice Ray
description: Slices foes with razor-thin streams of frozen energy.

name: Blizzard
description: Unleashes raging snowstorms that bury whole waves.

name: Soul Siphon
description: Extracts spirit essence to empower every strike.

name: Lightning Rod
description: Channels storms into a single, devastating discharge.

name: Laser Beam
description: Amplifies radiant energy into a precision beam.

name: Sacred Laser
description: Sweeps holy light across the grid, searing all foes.
descripcion: Daña enemigos en toda la cuadrícula.

name: Vertical Laser
description: Projects a column of light that cleaves upward.
descripcion: Proyecta un haz vertical que divide el campo de batalla.

name: Horizontal Laser
description: Emits a sweeping beam that slices laterally.
descripcion: Emite un rayo rasante que corta de lado a lado.

name: Storm
description: Calls forth chaotic winds and lightning strikes together.
descripcion: Fusión caótica que golpea en área.

name: Cornucopia
description: Blesses the party with abundance, bolstering regeneration.

name: Rattle
description: A rhythmic charm that rallies allies into tempo.
descripcion: Un amuleto rítmico que marca el tempo de la ofensiva.

name: War Horn
description: Trumpets a battle cry that hardens defences instantly.
descripcion: Hace resonar un grito marcial que refuerza las defensas.

name: Soul Reaper
description: Harvests vitality with every swing of its cursed blade.

name: Bottomless Chalice
description: A relic that never runs dry, suffusing allies with vigor.
descripcion: Una reliquia que nunca se vacía y colma de vigor al equipo.

name: Vampiric Sword
description: Imbued steel that steals blood on every cut.
descripcion: Acero imbuido que roba sangre con cada tajo.

name: Sharpshooter’s Crossbow
description: Launches precision bolts that rarely miss their mark.

name: Diamond Dagger
description: A flawless blade that pierces armour with ease.
descripcion: Una hoja perfecta que atraviesa armaduras sin esfuerzo.

name: Emerald Dagger
description: Inflicts verdant venom with each stab.
descripcion: Inyecta veneno esmeralda con cada estocada.

name: Ruby Dagger
description: Sears wounds with blazing gemstone heat.
descripcion: Cauteriza las heridas con el calor de la gema.

name: Sapphire Dagger
description: Chills targets to the core upon impact.
descripcion: Enfría hasta el núcleo con cada impacto.

name: Nuclear Bomb
description: Combines explosive force with lethal fallout.
descripcion: Fusiona una Bomba con una bola Veneno.

name: Black Hole
description: Crushes everything nearby into an inescapable void.
descripcion: Fusiona un Sol con un Oscuro.

name: Satan
description: Embodies unholy temptation and overwhelming power.
descripcion: Funde un Íncubo con un Súcubo.

name: Nosferatu
description: An ancient bloodlord that commands every nocturnal brood.
descripcion: Une Señor Vampiro, Rey Mosquito y Reina Araña.
